description: This file defines the BluetoothPeer class, which implements the Peer interface, representing a Bluetooth device as a peer in the nearby connections context. It includes methods for creating instances, retrieving device info, and parceling.

classes.name: BluetoothPeer
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth device as a peer, providing methods for identification, comparison, and parceling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a BluetoothPeer instance if the BluetoothDevice is of a type that can host a swap repo.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the device name or 'null' if not available.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the device name with the 'FDroid:' tag removed.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the resource ID for the Bluetooth icon.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on device address.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on device address.

methods.name: getRepoAddress
methods.description: Constructs the repository address URL based on device address.

methods.name: getFingerprint
methods.description: Returns null; fingerprint not stored for Bluetooth connections.

methods.name: shouldPromptForSwapBack
methods.description: Indicates whether to prompt for swap back; always false.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Writes the BluetoothDevice to a Parcel.
